note: Re-fired 5 Aug 2026 through the fixed provider path (MireyeProvider.field_request with example_locations). Same idempotency key as the original filing, so this is an idempotent replay: HTTP 200 rather than 201, and updated_at is unchanged from the first screening.

body.description: Count of permitted major stationary air pollution sources within a radius of a coordinate (default 50 km), and their permitted or reported annual emissions in tons per year for NOx, SO2, PM2.5 and CO. Facility name, distance and pollutant totals. Not just facility locations, which I can already get, but the emission rates.

example_locations.note: Loudoun County VA — ozone nonattainment (2015 8-hr, Moderate), the densest data center market in the world

body.use_case: PSD increment consumption. The Clean Air Act gives each area a finite budget for how much the air may degrade, shared across every source. If the sources already there consumed the increment, a new major source has nothing left to model into and is un-permittable at any timeline. I currently cannot compute this at all, and it is the single hardest number in my screen.
body.decision_threshold: If nearby major sources have consumed roughly 80 percent or more of the Class II increment for a pollutant, the project needs controls beyond BACT or a different site. Above 95 percent it is effectively a hard stop.

expected_volume.geography: every US county centroid plus ~3000 tracked project sites

freshness.changes_how_often: EPA NEI publishes every three years; Title V permits update continuously

must_not_be: facility location only with no emission rate

suggested.name: EPA National Emissions Inventory
suggested.why: reported annual emissions per facility per pollutant

suggested.name: EPA ECHO / Title V permits
suggested.why: permitted allowable emissions and major-source status
